title: Leviticus Bible Quiz - Chapter 12
description: Ten questions on Leviticus 12: the days of a mother's purification after childbirth and the offerings she brings.

questions.text: How long is a woman unclean after giving birth to a son?
questions.explanation: If a woman bears a male child, she shall be unclean seven days, as in the days of her monthly period.

questions.text: On which day is a baby boy to be circumcised?
questions.explanation: In the eighth day the flesh of his foreskin shall be circumcised.

questions.text: After the birth of a son, how long does the mother continue in the blood of purification?
questions.explanation: She shall continue in the blood of purification thirty-three days.

questions.text: What may the mother not do until the days of her purifying are completed?
questions.explanation: She shall not touch any holy thing, nor come into the sanctuary, until the days of her purifying are completed.

answers.text: Leave her house or do any kind of work
Eat bread or drink wine with her family
Speak with the priests at the Tent
Touch any holy thing or come into the sanctuary

questions.text: How long is a woman unclean after giving birth to a daughter?
questions.explanation: If she bears a female child, she shall be unclean two weeks, as in her period.

questions.text: After the birth of a daughter, how long does the mother continue in the blood of purification?
questions.explanation: After a daughter she shall continue in the blood of purification sixty-six days.

questions.text: What animal does the mother bring for a burnt offering when her purification is completed?
questions.explanation: She shall bring to the priest a year old lamb for a burnt offering.

questions.text: What does she bring for a sin offering?
questions.explanation: Along with the lamb she brings a young pigeon or a turtledove for a sin offering.

answers.text: A handful of fine flour with oil
A young male goat of the flock
A young pigeon or a turtledove
A jar of oil and some incense

questions.text: To whom and where does she bring her offerings?
questions.explanation: She brings them to the priest at the door of the Tent of Meeting.

answers.text: To the priest at the door of the Tent of Meeting
To the elders at the city gate
To the Levites at the camp's edge

questions.text: What may she bring if she cannot afford a lamb?
questions.explanation: If she cannot afford a lamb, she shall take two turtledoves or two young pigeons, one for a burnt offering and one for a sin offering.

answers.text: Two turtledoves or two young pigeons
A tenth of an ephah of fine flour
A shekel of silver for the priest
A young goat instead of a lamb
